cues.text: Guess we all are born with parts to play
Some of us are stars, and some are just in the way
cues.translation: 누구는 별이 되고 누구는 그저 방해일 뿐이지

cues.text: I know I was meant for glory
cues.translation: 난 영광을 위해 태어난 걸 알아

cues.text: But that's never what my story brings
cues.translation: 하지만 내 이야긴 늘 그렇지 않아

cues.text: And yet I keep on waiting
When you have the passion and the drive
You expect your moment center stage to arrive
cues.translation: 무대 한가운데 설 순간이 오길 바라지

cues.text: I show up with heart a blazing
Ready to achieve amazing things
But I'm left waiting in the wings
I hear my cue
And yet I'm kept there, waiting
Know what to do
It's always someone else who sings
While I'm left waiting in the wings
And so I keep on keeping on
My chances come and then I blink and they're gone
cues.translation: 기회는 오고 난 눈 깜빡이면 사라져

cues.text: Always overlooked unfairly
While pretending that it barely stings
But it stings, yes it stings
And I'll shed no tears
I'll only keep on waiting
If no one cheers
Well, I can keep on waiting
cues.translation: 그래도 난 계속 기다릴 수 있어

cues.text: Who cares how loud
The silence rings
You'll find me waiting in the wings
cues.translation: 날 보게 될 거야 무대 뒤에서 기다리는
